one_line: Eastern Ganga emperor of Odisha who projected power from Kapilash to Konark in the mid-13th century.

appearance.age_look: late 30s to early 40s, tall, broad-shouldered, athletic build
appearance.face: oval face with strong cheekbones and a firm jaw, medium wheatish complexion, sharp dark eyes under straight brows, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along the jawline, default expression calm yet commanding with a slight, confident half-smile
appearance.hair: thick black hair drawn back into a high, smooth topknot at the crown, bound with a narrow gold band; a small, cylindrical golden crest ornament sits at the front of the topknot; no veil, just the jewelled band and crest as royal headwear
appearance.costume: royal Kalinga-style attire: a knee-length dhoti of rich crimson silk wrapped tightly at the waist and pleated in front, edged with narrow gold borders, worn with a fitted, short-sleeved golden-yellow silk tunic covering the torso and upper thighs, the tunic decorated with subtle woven geometric motifs in slightly darker gold; over this, a cream-coloured silk uttariya drape with thin red and gold stripes along the borders, flowing from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back like a trailing robe; broad gold waistband with a central oval ruby-like gem; jewellery includes a layered necklace of small gold beads with a central larger pendant, medium-sized circular gold earrings, a pair of gold armlets on the upper arms with simple floral relief, and multiple slim gold bangles on each wrist; bare feet in simple brown leather sandals with toe loop and ankle strap, suitable for both court and campaign, keeping the overall look dignified yet practical
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Kalinga-style sword with a broad single-edged steel blade, a simple gold cross-guard, and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in deep red cord, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard with gold fittings and worn at his left hip

ref_desc: Narasimhadeva I has an oval wheatish face with a neat moustache and beard, black hair in a high topknot with a gold crest, wearing a crimson dhoti, golden-yellow tunic, cream striped uttariya, gold jewellery, sandals, and a curved Kalinga sword at his left hip with these colours dominant.
sheet_prompt: Draw Narasimhadeva I in dynamic shonen anime style as a full-body model sheet: a tall, athletic man in his late 30s with an oval wheatish face, sharp dark eyes, straight brows, and a neatly trimmed moustache with short beard along the jawline, hair pulled into a high, smooth black topknot bound by a narrow gold band and small cylindrical gold crest. Show him fully clothed in 13th-century Eastern Ganga royal attire: a knee-length crimson silk dhoti with narrow gold borders, a fitted short-sleeved golden-yellow silk tunic covering the torso and upper thighs with subtle geometric patterns, and a cream silk uttariya drape with thin red and gold striped borders flowing from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back like a trailing robe. Add a broad gold waistband with a central oval red gem, layered gold bead necklace with pendant, circular gold earrings, simple gold armlets on his upper arms, and several thin gold bangles on each wrist. Put brown leather sandals with toe loop and ankle strap on his feet. At his left hip, show a slightly curved Kalinga-style sword with a broad single-edged steel blade, simple gold cross-guard, and dark wooden hilt wrapped in deep red cord, sheathed in a plain brown leather scabbard with gold fittings. Use crimson red, golden yellow, cream, brown leather, and dark wood as the dominant colours, and pose him in a calm yet commanding stance that feels dignified and heroic.
